instances.name: reg800k
instances.description: Random 10-regular graph on 800,000 vertices, unit weights. The textbook case.

instances.name: gnm600k
instances.description: Erdos-Renyi graph, 600,000 vertices and 4.8 million edges (average degree 16), weights 1-100.

instances.name: pow600k
instances.description: Preferential-attachment graph, 600,000 vertices, 6 edges per newcomer, unit weights: a few hubs of degree in the thousands, most vertices of degree 6.

instances.name: tri900
instances.description: Triangular lattice on a 900 x 900 torus (810,000 vertices, degree 6), weights 1-100. Every triangle must leave one edge uncut: a frustrated antiferromagnet.

instances.name: geo600k
instances.description: Random geometric graph: 600,000 points in a square, pairs within a radius joined (average degree 12), closer pairs heavier. Dense local clusters of triangles.

instances.name: comm600k
instances.description: Planted partition: 600 hidden communities of 1,000 vertices, 80% of the 4.8 million edges inside a community, unit weights, labels shuffled.
